label: DEMO task candidates: not official guidance

SRC-NYCEM-HEAT.issuer: NYC Emergency Management + NYC Health Department
SRC-NYCEM-HEAT.title: City officials urge New Yorkers to stay safe in Tuesday's heat (press release, 2025-07-07)
SRC-NYCEM-HEAT.limits: Seasonal press release, not a standing guidance page; re-check for a current canonical NYC EM heat page before final submission.

SRC-NWS-OKX.title: Extreme Heat page: alert criteria and safety actions
SRC-NWS-OKX.limits: Criteria are for the NWS New York office area; confirm applicability to the Bronx zone via the alert's own geography fields.

SRC-CDC-HEAT.title: About Heat and Your Health
SRC-CDC-HEAT.limits: General public guidance; gives symptoms but no first-aid steps.

tasks.title: Confirm air conditioning works in the rooms where at-risk people spend time; clean filters
tasks.caveat: AC status is DEMO_SYNTHETIC unless a verified source supplies it. Never state a real site's AC status.

tasks.title: Count the at-risk people expected on site (older adults, young children, people with heart disease, diabetes or asthma, people living alone). Counts only, no names
tasks.caveat: No personal data. NYC EM says 60+, CDC says 65+; show both and let the manager choose.

tasks.title: Find the nearest cooling center or free air-conditioned space and confirm it is open today
tasks.demo_proof: Screenshot or link of the City cooling-options map with retrieval time
tasks.caveat: Source says locations may have changed. Never claim a sampled site is an active cooling center.

tasks.title: Sign the facility lead up for Notify NYC alerts (text NotifyNYC to 692-692)
tasks.caveat: Use a demo role, not a real person's number.

tasks.title: Check the power-outage plan for electric medical equipment and refrigerated medication
tasks.caveat: Do not collect medical details. A checklist tick is not proof of readiness.

tasks.title: Move strenuous activity and outdoor programs out of 11 AM–4 PM
tasks.caveat: Time window comes from NYC EM guidance for the public; the manager may adjust it.

tasks.title: Make drinking water available and schedule water breaks
Set a buddy system and shaded or cool rest breaks for anyone working outdoors
tasks.demo_proof: DEMO buddy list using role IDs (staff_demo_01)
tasks.caveat: Source says employers must provide water, rest and shade to outdoor workers. Do not turn this into a legal-compliance claim.

tasks.title: Close blinds and shades, keep doors shut while AC runs, and run heat-producing appliances early morning or late night
tasks.caveat: Low-cost step; do not present it as a substitute for cooling.

tasks.title: Brief staff on heat-illness warning signs and when to call 911
tasks.caveat: Copy the 911 criteria from the source verbatim. Do not paraphrase medical guidance with the model.

tasks.title: Check on at-risk people at intervals the manager sets
tasks.caveat: The interval is our design choice, not sourced. Label it as a manager decision.

tasks.title: Use fans only if indoor temperature is below 90°F; otherwise move people to a cooler space
tasks.caveat: Applies to indoor fan use only; the manager decides where people move.
